name: Cairnai
bio: Cairnai was a Titan formed by curiosity. The Eldrin were long fascinated by the mysterious stone circles that dotted their kingdom, and hoped performing a Titan Rite would reveal their true purpose. While they didn't get an answer, what they got was a towering stone golem, whose might could crush any interloper.
subtitle: The Walking Ruin
